# Pull Request Submission

Please complete the following sections to describe your proposed contribution to the Homonoid Design System. Ensure your changes adhere to our architectural foundations and pass all verification checks.

<br>

### Summary of Changes
<br>

Provide a concise explanation of the motivation and context for this change. Describe what was modified, added, or removed across the affected packages. Reference related issue numbers where applicable.

<br>

### Design System Alignment
<br>

Explain how this contribution upholds the core architectural pillars of the Homonoid Design System.

1. Object Continuity: Confirm components maintain visual identity across lifecycle updates and state changes.

2. Dimensional Stability: Confirm containers allocate space in advance for loading indicators and dynamic content to prevent layout shifts.

3. Token First Foundations: Confirm styling utilizes semantic tokens exclusively with zero arbitrary hardcoded styling.

4. Sensory Accessibility: Confirm all interactive elements provide keyboard navigation, clear focus boundaries, and screen reader announcements.

<br>

### Verification and Testing
<br>

Document the steps undertaken to validate this pull request locally.

1. Automated Tests: Confirm unit, integration, and type check suites execute successfully across the monorepo.

2. Visual Inspection: Confirm visual stability and component interactions in the local showcase documentation application.

3. Cross Browser Validation: Confirm expected rendering and behavior across modern desktop and mobile browsers.

<br>

### Visual Evidence
<br>

Include screenshots, screen recordings, or interactive deployment links demonstrating before and after interaction states for any visual or kinetic changes.
